correctness.rationale: The one-dimensional descending-link characterization is justified by primary source arXiv:2609.06844v1. An exhaustive 720-ordering enumeration gives exactly 139 faces; all 328 directed Hasse incidences are checked for acyclicity under an explicitly specified 66-pair matching. Seven critical cells remain (1,1,5,0), and exact integral unit-pivot reduction yields a zero differential. The resulting CW model has one loop and five trivially attached two-cells, yielding the claimed integral wedge. Reproducible standalone verifier runs to ALL_VERIFY_OK.

value.rationale: The graph is the smallest nonuniform theta obtained by a single subdivision of K_{2,3}; it is a natural boundary case beyond source families (paths, cycles, stars, simplices). The mixed-dimensional integral homotopy wedge, optimal seven-cell Morse model and explicit zero attaching-degree certificate characterize a meaningful subdivision phenomenon, rather than a raw small Betti table. No unproved extension is claimed.
